erp-التقارير.title: ERP Reports
erp-التقارير.body:
29. Reports Engine and Catalog

Reports are not an add-on. They are the reason the system is bought: the user enters data

all day to read a single number at the end of it. A slow report, or one that cannot be exported,

cancels the value of everything beneath it.

29.1 A unified engine, not scattered reports

The problem

Writing each report as a query, a controller, and a screen means: 200 reports = 600 files,

and different behavior in each one (this one exports and that one does not, this one saves the filter and that one does not).

The solution

One definition per report, and one engine that reads it:

ReportDefinition::make('trial_balance')

Param::dateRange('period')->required(),

Param::select('branch_id')->from('branches')->multiple(),

Param::select('cost_center_id')->from('cost_centers')->tree(),

Param::number('level')->default(3)->max(9),

Param::toggle('hide_zero')->default(true),

Param::toggle('include_closing')->default(false),

])

Col::text('code', 'الحساب')->width(120)->sticky(),

Col::text('name_ar', 'الاسم')->width(280),

Col::money('opening_debit', 'افتتاحي مدين'),

Col::money('opening_credit', 'افتتاحي دائن'),

Col::money('period_debit', 'حركة مدين'),

Col::money('period_credit', 'حركة دائن'),

erp-الاستراتيجيات.title: ERP Strategies
erp-الاستراتيجيات.body:
30. Strategies

Six cross-cutting decisions that touch every module. They are settled here once, and are not re-debated in

each module separately.

30.1 Inventory and costing strategy

The method is chosen at two levels

Company setting (cost_method) ← the default for all items

↓ overridden by

Item setting (items.cost_method) ← for a specific item

Why two levels? A company uses FIFO for everything, but its manufactured items need

standard cost, and some of its homogeneous items are fine with the weighted average.

The adopted decision: `fifo` is the default method for a new company.

The reason: the Syrian market has high inflation and sharp exchange-rate volatility. The weighted average

blends the cost of goods bought at an exchange rate of 9,000 with others at 14,000, producing

a cost that matches no real purchase, and showing a phantom profit during inflation. FIFO

keeps every piece at its actual cost.

The engineering consequence: stock_valuation_layers is a critical table, not optional,

and it must work from phase 1, not from a later phase.

FIFO — by layers · Default

stock_valuation_layers: every receipt creates a layer with its quantity and cost, and every

issue consumes the oldest remaining layers.

Layer 1: 100 pieces × 500 (2026/01/10)

Layer 2: 50 pieces × 600 (2026/02/05)

Selling 120 pieces:

100 from layer 1 = 50,000 → exhausted (qty_remaining = 0)

erp-هيكل-الواجهة.title: ERP UI Structure
erp-هيكل-الواجهة.body:
31. The New UI Structure

A radical change: the "Launcher + a sidebar per module" model is abandoned entirely,

and replaced by a menu bar + document tabs + status bar — the structure of a real desktop

application, working in the browser and in Electron with the same code.

31.1 Why we are changing

What the current model breaks

Flaw

Daily impact

One screen at a time

The accountant enters an invoice, needs an item's balance, leaves the screen — and loses what they entered

The sidebar hides what is not in its module

Want a customer statement while in inventory? A three-click trip through the home page

The Launcher is an unnecessary intermediary

A full screen whose job is to choose a module — a wasted click on every navigation

228 pixels of width are always taken

The invoice table gets narrow, and columns are clipped

No discovery

50 modules and 240 screens are not shown in a sidebar — the user does not know what they have

The mouse is mandatory

No keyboard access to a full menu

What the new model gives

Gain

How

Multiple documents at once

erp-خطة-التنفيذ.title: ERP Implementation Plan
erp-خطة-التنفيذ.body:
32. Implementation Plan

From Mizan v1 (52 tables, 7 working modules) to Mizan ERP (~290 tables,

50 modules). The path, the migration, and the risks.

32.1 The principle: parallel build, not a sudden replacement

The current system works and is in use. Shutting it down for months to build the replacement is a mistake.

Figure 1

The conversion rule: no user is moved to v2 until it produces a trial balance

exactly identical to the v1 trial balance on the same data, with a difference of zero — not an "acceptable difference".

32.2 Phases

Phase 0 — Foundation · 3 weeks

Work

Deliverable

The new schema for the core · identity · gl domains

52 migrations — one per table (§32.7)

The global scope enforced on company and branch

+ its structural test

+ its simulator

Module skeleton, contracts, and events

The complete new UI shell

shell/ — menus, tabs, status

The partitioned audit log

Completion criterion: it is possible to create a company, a chart of accounts, a balanced manual journal entry,

and display it in a trial balance — all inside the new shell.

ar.name: Manex — منصة الإدارة المتكاملة
ar.tagline: نظام لإدارة المؤسسة: الموظفون والفروع والأقسام، والتعاميم، وأرشيف الملفات، ودليل جهات الاتصال — على الويب وسطح المكتب.
ar.summary:
Manex منصة لإدارة المؤسسات تجمع شؤون الموظفين والهيكل التنظيمي والتواصل الداخلي في نظام واحد: سجل موظفين بفروعه وأقسامه، والتعاميم، وأرشيف ملفات بصلاحيات وحصص لكل دور، ودليل تواصل، وإدارة جهات الاتصال.

بُنيت على معمارية معيارية بـ Laravel 12 (18 وحدة و61 جدولاً على PostgreSQL 18)، بواجهة React 19 عربية بالكامل (RTL)، وتطبيق سطح مكتب مبني بـ Electron يعمل داخل شبكة المؤسسة.

hi.name: Manex — एकीकृत प्रबंधन प्लेटफ़ॉर्म
hi.tagline: संस्था प्रबंधन का सिस्टम: कर्मचारी, शाखाएँ और विभाग, सर्कुलर, फ़ाइल आर्काइव और संपर्क डायरेक्टरी, वेब और डेस्कटॉप दोनों पर।
hi.summary:
Manex संस्था प्रबंधन का प्लेटफ़ॉर्म है जो कर्मचारी मामलों, संगठन संरचना और आंतरिक संचार को एक ही सिस्टम में जोड़ता है: शाखाओं और विभागों वाला कर्मचारी रजिस्टर, सर्कुलर, हर भूमिका के लिए अनुमतियों और कोटे वाला फ़ाइल आर्काइव, संचार डायरेक्टरी और संपर्क प्रबंधन।

यह Laravel 12 पर मॉड्यूलर आर्किटेक्चर में बना है (PostgreSQL 18 पर 18 मॉड्यूल और 61 टेबल), इसका React 19 इंटरफ़ेस पूरी तरह अरबी (RTL) में है, और Electron से बना डेस्कटॉप ऐप संस्था के नेटवर्क के भीतर चलता है।

preview-notes.title: इस प्रीव्यू के बारे में
preview-notes.body:
लाइव प्रीव्यू सिस्टम का इंटरफ़ेस जैसा है वैसा ही दिखाता है, लेकिन बिना सर्वर के: डेटा डेमो है और केवल आपके ब्राउज़र में सहेजा जाता है। आप जो भी बदलाव करते हैं वह आपके पास ही रहता है और «डेटा रीसेट» बटन से मिट जाता है।

पूरा सिस्टम संस्था के नेटवर्क के भीतर एक Laravel सर्वर पर PostgreSQL डेटाबेस के साथ चलता है, जिसे शेयर्ड होस्टिंग पर प्रदर्शित नहीं किया जा सकता।
steps: लॉगिन फ़ॉर्म के नीचे किसी एक डेमो अकाउंट का बटन दबाएँ, ईमेल अपने-आप भर जाएगा (पासवर्ड: password)।
मॉड्यूल के बीच नेविगेट करें: मॉनिटरिंग डैशबोर्ड, कर्मचारी, डायरेक्टरी, ड्राइव, सर्कुलर, कार्य आदि।
अलग-अलग भूमिकाओं वाले अकाउंट आज़माएँ और अनुमतियों व मेनू का अंतर देखें।
मूल स्थिति में लौटने के लिए «डेटा रीसेट» का उपयोग करें।

zh.name: Manex：综合管理平台
zh.tagline: 机构管理系统：员工、分支机构与部门、通知公告、文件归档和通讯录，支持网页端与桌面端。
zh.summary:
Manex 是一个机构管理平台，将人事、组织架构和内部沟通整合到一个系统中：包含分支机构与部门的员工档案、通知公告、按角色设置权限和配额的文件归档、通讯目录以及联系人管理。

它基于 Laravel 12 的模块化架构构建（18 个模块，PostgreSQL 18 中共 61 张表），配有完整支持从右到左排版的 React 19 界面，以及基于 Electron 的桌面应用，可在机构内网中运行。

preview-notes.title: 关于此预览
preview-notes.body:
实时预览按原样展示系统界面，但没有服务器：数据为演示数据，仅保存在您的浏览器中，您所做的任何修改都只留在本地，点击“重置数据”即可清除。

完整系统运行在机构内网的 Laravel 服务器上，并使用 PostgreSQL 数据库，因此无法部署到共享主机上展示。
steps: 打开页面顶部的实时预览。
点击登录表单下方的某个演示账号按钮，邮箱会自动填充（密码：password）。
在各模块之间浏览：监控面板、员工、通讯录、云盘、通告、任务等。
使用不同角色的账号，体验权限和菜单的差异。
使用“重置数据”恢复到初始状态。

tr.name: Manex — Bütünleşik Yönetim Platformu
tr.tagline: Kurum yönetimi sistemi: çalışanlar, şubeler ve departmanlar, genelgeler, dosya arşivi ve rehber — web ve masaüstünde.
tr.summary:
Manex; personel işlerini, organizasyon yapısını ve kurum içi iletişimi tek bir sistemde toplayan bir kurum yönetim platformudur: şubeleri ve departmanlarıyla çalışan kaydı, genelgeler, rol bazlı yetki ve kotalı dosya arşivi, iletişim rehberi ve kişi yönetimi.

Laravel 12 üzerinde modüler bir mimariyle (PostgreSQL 18 üzerinde 18 modül ve 61 tablo), tamamen Arapça (RTL) bir React 19 arayüzüyle ve kurumun ağında çalışan, Electron ile geliştirilmiş bir masaüstü uygulamasıyla geliştirilmiştir.

preview-notes.title: Bu önizleme hakkında
preview-notes.body:
Canlı önizleme sistemin arayüzünü olduğu gibi gösterir, ancak sunucu olmadan çalışır: veriler deneme amaçlıdır ve yalnızca tarayıcınızda saklanır; yaptığınız her değişiklik sizde kalır ve «Verileri sıfırla» düğmesiyle silinir.

Tam sistem, kurumun ağı içindeki bir Laravel sunucusunda PostgreSQL veritabanıyla çalışır; bu da paylaşımlı bir barındırmada gösterilemez.
steps: E-postanın otomatik dolması için giriş formunun altındaki deneme hesaplarından birinin düğmesine basın (parola: password).
Modüller arasında gezinin: takip paneli, çalışanlar, rehber, drive, genelgeler, görevler ve diğerleri.
Yetkilerin ve menülerin nasıl değiştiğini görmek için farklı rollerdeki hesapları deneyin.
İlk duruma dönmek için «Verileri sıfırla» düğmesini kullanın.

preview-notes.title: About this preview
preview-notes.body:
The live preview shows the system interface as it is, but without a server: the data is sample data stored in your browser only, and any change you make stays with you and is discarded by the "Reset data" button.

The full system runs on a Laravel server inside the organization's network with a PostgreSQL database, which cannot be hosted on shared hosting.
steps: Open the live preview from the top.
Click the button of one of the demo accounts below the login form to fill in the email automatically (password: password).
Move between modules: dashboard, employees, directory, drive, circulars, tasks, and others.
Try accounts with different roles to see how permissions and menus differ.
Use "Reset data" to return to the original state.
